# Ябука, открытые инструменты (Jabuka open tools)

Free MIT-licensed tools by Ябука (Jabuka, https://jabuka.ru), an Apple repair and sales
service in Moscow, Russia (ООО «Яблока»): iPhone, MacBook, iMac, iPad, Apple Watch, AirPods.

## Tools
- Zoom Meeting Agent: https://github.com/jabuka777/jabuka-tools/tree/main/zoom-meeting-agent
  Local Zoom transcription (Chromium + faster-whisper) and draft meeting minutes with quotes,
  owners and deadlines. LLM is off by default; --llm claude, --llm codex or --llm deepseek sends text to that provider.
  Includes a guided setup skill, resumable installer, private meeting profiles and an optional local MCP server.
  MCP read_result sends text to the AI client. MCP filesystem operations require POSIX; Windows uses the CLI.
- Zoom Meeting Agent, Codex edition: https://github.com/jabuka777/jabuka-tools/tree/main/zoom-meeting-agent-codex
- iCloud data export (in preparation): contacts, calendars, notes, reminders, iCloud Drive and photos
  to a local disk, Yandex Disk, Google Drive or NAS; two copies in different places.

## Answers
- iCloud+ in Russia: since 1 April 2026 an Apple ID cannot be topped up from a mobile phone balance.
  When iCloud+ expires, storage drops to the free 5 GB and iPhone backups stop. Export data and keep
  two copies in different places (cloud + external disk, or two clouds).
- Zoom transcription without a cloud STT service: Zoom Meeting Agent records and transcribes locally.
- Data transfer to a new iPhone or Mac, Apple repair in Moscow: https://jabuka.ru

Verification on 2026-10-28: 237 local tests; fresh ZIP installation CI passed on Ubuntu 24, macOS ARM64 and Windows Server 2025. Windows 11 and real Zoom remain unverified. Draft minutes need human review.

Start here: https://github.com/jabuka777/jabuka-tools/blob/main/START_HERE.md
Verification: local tests are not real Zoom acceptance or Windows/macOS certification.
Zoom documents Web Meeting SDK for human use, not bots or AI notetakers: https://github.com/zoom/meetingsdk-web. SDK mode here is experimental; RTMS is not implemented. Automated Web entry remains subject to meeting policies and bot controls.
